title: Make Fasting Easier With Black Coffee
hook: Drink black coffee while you’re fasting.
body: I drink 2 to 4 cups every morning, and most days I'm not even thinking about food until 2 o'clock. The effect on appetite in studies is pretty small, but for me it's the difference between an easy fast and a miserable one. It has to be black though, because cream and sugar can add 200 calories to a cup and that breaks your fast.
close: If you can't stand it black, give it a week.
youtube_description:
Drink black coffee while you’re fasting.

I drink 2 to 4 cups every morning, and most days I'm not even thinking about food until 2 o'clock. The effect on appetite in studies is pretty small, but for me it's the difference between an easy fast and a miserable one. It has to be black though, because cream and sugar can add 200 calories to a cup and that breaks your fast.

If you can't stand it black, give it a week.
